description: Asks whether the same one-expression battery (33 expressions across the function families, including names the sandbox may refuse) gives the same value, tag and failure through DAO and through ADODB.Connection with Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0 (Mode adModeRead) on the same file: each expression is its own SELECT expr FROM One, first through DAO then through ADO, each recordset reading Name, Type and Value of every field. Both engines' modules are recorded once after both are loaded.
